name: Phase Autopilot
description: Opt-in per-task `autoRun` ("Run through") flag that auto-starts the next phase when a phase session finishes. startTaskPhase records `boundTask {id, phase}` on the spawned SavedSession; a multi-task "Start all" batch (startTaskPhaseBatch) records `boundBatch {ids, phase}` instead (sessionTypes.ts) — hooks/usage/sessions-view only read boundTask, autopilot reads both via sessionMembers(). mcp-core notify-server includes the sender's sessionId in notifications; NotifyServer (notifications.ts) fires onNotify, exposed by SessionManager.onNotify. registerAutopilot (commands/taskFlow.ts) maps the event to the bound task(s), re-reads each from the task-store and asks the pure decideNextPhase (phaseAutopilot.ts) for {start} or {stop: reason} per task. Members whose next phase matches are re-batched into ONE session via startTaskPhaseBatch in the finished session's worktree (one agent with a queue, never N agents on one tree). Stops: autorun off, needs_input, task done/phase cleared, phase unchanged after done (blocked), or next phase fix with open high-priority review-finding subtasks. Fix is the last phase of the flow (Plan → Implement → Review → Fix): Fix, or a Review that files nothing, clears `phase` and marks the task done. One verdict per session on 'done' (markAutopilotHandled flags boundTask or boundBatch); a live session already bound (singly or in a batch) to the same task+phase blocks a double-start. UI: "Run through" checkbox + "autopilot" chip on Phase Board cards and the column footer's bulk checkbox, and in TaskDetailPane's PhaseStepper. autoRun is serialized in task frontmatter only when true.
guidelines: Decision logic stays in the pure decideNextPhase; keep I/O in registerAutopilot.
Autopilot starts phases only through startTaskPhase / startTaskPhaseBatch so manual and automatic starts share one path.
`task.phase` names the NEXT phase; 'unchanged after done' means task.phase === the session's bound phase.
Any session that should be auto-advanced must carry boundTask or boundBatch — a session with neither is invisible to autopilot.
Add or change a phase ONLY in phase-prompts.cjs plus the type unions (VALID_PHASES, TaskPhase d.ts files, ui TaskPhase/COLUMNS/PHASE_FLOW, tasks-server enums).
anti_patterns: Do not auto-start past a high-priority review finding or a needs_input stop.
Do not trigger from notifications without a sessionId or a bound task/batch.
Do not fan a finished batch out into one session per task — re-batch members that share a next phase.
Do not re-add a Ship/commit/PR phase after Fix — it was tried (Oct 2026) and removed; committing and PRs are left to the user. The optional `prUrl` task field survives as plain data only.
